minutes.headline: Select Board heard cannabis, drainage and Bright Farms TIF items, passed a telework policy, and set a Monday TIF meeting.
minutes.summary: The board heard an introductory cannabis retail proposal for 88 Mass Ave, an engineer's concept for Flat Hill Road drainage, and revised Bright Farms TIF language. It approved a temporary telework policy, the October minutes and a consent calendar for special town meeting, and discussed demolishing the old primary school. A short Zoom meeting on the TIF was set for Monday at 6:30.

budget_items.what_was_said: Applicant says the host agreement would pay the town a percentage of gross sales, and gave the town a draft to review.
Engineer estimated survey cost for the right of way; the town manager could not say whether funds exist without reviewing the DPW budget.
The alternate discharge to the brook would nearly double the length of buried pipe and raise cost.
A simple conceptual rendering was said to cost a couple thousand dollars; the board asked for volunteers.
Town manager listed articles: prior year bills, PACC capital transfer, sewer reserve transfer, bond premiums, salary bylaw.
Brownfields committee approved additional funding for a phase three assessment.

what_happened.line: The Select Board approved a COVID-19 temporary telework policy by a 5-0 roll call vote.
The board passed the consent calendar of special town meeting articles 5-0 by roll call, passing over article 14.
A short Zoom meeting was set for Monday, Nov 16 at 6:30 to take up the Bright Farms TIF agreement; final language goes to town counsel.
The board heard an introductory cannabis retail proposal for 88 Mass Ave; an outreach meeting is to be set for early January.
On Flat Hill Road drainage, the engineer is to get survey quotes; the town manager could not say whether funds exist without reviewing the DPW budget.

why_it_matters: The special town meeting articles include transfers and bills that residents will be asked to vote on, and the Bright Farms TIF agreement would set a tax incentive for a local business.
Flat Hill Road drainage and the cannabis host agreement, which would pay the town a share of sales, could affect future town spending and revenue.
watch_next: Monday, Nov 16 at 6:30: Zoom meeting of the Select Board on the Bright Farms TIF agreement.
Early January: cannabis applicant outreach meeting and a meeting on the old primary school, both to be placed on agendas.

reconciliation.what: Our minutes against the minutes the town published. caption_error = the same fact the captions rendered badly, resolved by the official reading shown beside the as-heard one; discrepancy = a substantive difference, flagged and not resolved. Neither record is treated as the referee.
reconciliation.summary: Both records agree on the two votes, which passed 5-0, and on most headline figures, such as $120,000, $68,097.59, $113,488 and $6,000. Our minutes cover Flat Hill drainage and the old primary school, which the official minutes lack. The Bright Farms follow-up meeting is described differently: ours says it was set for Nov 16, while the official minutes call it only a suggestion.
